sub_graphs.title: EIP-2378: EIP Eligibility Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transitions of an EIP through the eligibility process for hard fork inclusion

nodes.label: EIP in Draft State
nodes.description: EIP has been created and is in initial draft status

nodes.label: Present at AllCoreDevs
nodes.description: EIP author presents proposal at AllCoreDevs call for discussion

nodes.label: EIP Under Discussion
nodes.description: EIP is being evaluated by Core Developers at ACD calls

nodes.label: Core Devs Reach Consensus
nodes.description: Core Developers achieve rough consensus on EIP advancement

nodes.label: Eligible for Inclusion
nodes.description: EIP has been approved for implementation and testing (no activation block yet)

nodes.label: Implementation Phase
nodes.description: Client teams are implementing the EIP specification

nodes.label: Testing Phase
nodes.description: EIP implementation is being tested across clients

nodes.label: Accepted for Fork
nodes.description: EIP has been assigned to a specific hard fork with activation block

nodes.label: Deployed on Mainnet
nodes.description: EIP is active on Ethereum mainnet

edges.label: Author creates and submits EIP draft
Consensus not achieved, return to draft
Hard fork activates at scheduled block

external_entities.name: EIP Author
external_entities.description: Developer or researcher proposing an Ethereum improvement

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2378: Core Dev Governance Process
sub_graphs.description: Models the governance decision-making process for EIP eligibility

nodes.label: AllCoreDevs Call Scheduled
nodes.description: Regular ACD call is scheduled with EIP discussion on agenda

nodes.label: Discuss EIP Proposal
nodes.description: Core developers discuss technical merits and concerns of the EIP

nodes.label: Feedback Collected
nodes.description: Technical feedback and concerns have been documented

nodes.label: Assess Rough Consensus
nodes.description: Determine if sufficient agreement exists among core developers

nodes.label: Consensus Exists
nodes.description: Core developers agree EIP should advance

nodes.label: No Consensus
nodes.description: Insufficient agreement, EIP needs more work

nodes.label: Document Decision
nodes.description: Record decision in meeting notes with link to EIP

nodes.label: Decision Recorded
nodes.description: Meeting notes document the eligibility decision

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2378: Eligibility Criteria Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation criteria that must be met for EIP eligibility

nodes.label: EIP Candidate for Eligibility
nodes.description: EIP has been proposed for eligible status

nodes.label: Check Conceptual Support
nodes.description: Verify core developers support the EIP conceptually

nodes.label: Conceptually Supported
nodes.description: Core developers agree with the EIP's goals and approach

nodes.label: Check Implementation Willingness
nodes.description: Verify client teams would accept PRs to implement the EIP

nodes.label: Implementation Acceptable
nodes.description: Client teams willing to accept implementation PRs for testing

nodes.label: Check Documentation Link
nodes.description: Verify EIP includes link to ACD meeting notes

nodes.label: Fully Validated
nodes.description: All eligibility criteria have been met

nodes.label: Validation Failed
nodes.description: One or more eligibility criteria not met

ambiguities.text: The term 'rough consensus' is used without a precise definition of what constitutes sufficient agreement.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume rough consensus means a clear majority of active core developers agree, without formal voting requirements. Interpret as IETF-style rough consensus.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define a process for revoking eligibility once granted.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume eligibility can be revoked through the same ACD consensus process that granted it, though this is not documented.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'well written PRs' for implementation acceptance is subjective.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this refers to PRs that follow client codebase conventions, include tests, and properly implement the specification.

implicit_assumptions.description: Core developers participating in ACD calls represent the interests of the Ethereum ecosystem broadly.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Governance capture could lead to harmful EIPs being approved for inclusion.

implicit_assumptions.description: ACD meeting notes accurately capture the consensus decision and reasoning.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inaccurate notes could misrepresent decisions, leading to disputes about EIP status.

implicit_assumptions.description: The EIP process continues to function with volunteer participation from client developers.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If key client teams stop participating, the governance process could break down.
